page.notes: Greek word "ἐπεγδήξι᾽α" is a best reading of a damaged Greek word (ἐπηρείαν-type term); letters uncertain, marked by copy approximation. The line "quam ad novum Episcopatum" reads "quam ad nouum Episcopatum" in print; "Synodis Provin-" hyphen retained. Several words in the second half of the page (e.g. "Ecclesiis" in the line "Ecclesiis invitis", "sancitos") are copied as printed and not individually marked; the scan is slightly blurred at the right edge. Running head is partly obscured by a dark mark over "Historia" and "motuum", reading "HISTORIA MOTUUM" as best seen.
